title: Option to animate or badge folder view compact representation upon content change
line: A Folder View widget in the panel now shows a badge with the number of new files in its folder until you open it.
explanation: A Folder View widget in a panel only shows its folder icon, so nothing hinted that a file had just arrived in it (for example a finished download in ~/Downloads). FolderModel now remembers the items that its directory lister reports after the initial listing, follows renames (so a .part file that becomes the final file still counts once) and deletions, and exposes the number still visible in the view as newItemCount. The widget sets its badgeText to that count, which the panel icon already draws as a badge, and clears it whenever the popup is opened or closed.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: badge Folder View panel icon with new items

A Folder View widget in a panel gave no sign that a file had arrived in
its folder, such as a finished download. The model now counts the items
added after listing, and the icon shows them as a badge until opened.

BUG: 429304

media.caption: Three files were just added to ~/Downloads: the panel's Folder View icon looks the same as before.
Same three files added: the panel icon shows a "3" badge until the popup is opened.
